listings.description: Why this role is exciting Rohlik is the leading Central European e-grocer. More than a million customers buy their groceries from us through Rohlik.cz , Knuspr.de , Kifli.hu , Gurkerl.at and Sezamo.ro , choosing from over 17,000 items, delivered within a couple of hours in 15-minute windows. We are building the autonomous grocer. Maia, our AI assistant, already talks to customers and builds their orders; agents are moving into our buying and logistics; vision models are learning to watch quality. The next frontier is physical: robots taking over more and more of the work in our fulfilment centres, until fresh food moves from producers to households at a cost nobody else can match. We are setting out to record how our own people handle groceries and to turn those recordings into a training corpus for manipulation policies. Our warehouses already log what happened on every pick and every quality check, so the recordings can carry labels most datasets never get. Making that hold is part of the job. You decide what makes an hour of footage trainable — before we bank hundreds of them. What you will own and deliver The capture spec. Cameras, mounts, calibration, and what disqualifies an episode. You write it before we buy the fleet and enforce it after. When the spec and the floor disagree, you go to the floor and find out which one is wrong. Ground truth. Hand pose is the signal that transfers from human video to robot policies, and warehouse reality — work gloves, occlusion, cold halls — is exactly where the published models struggle. You own how we measure that and how we close the gap. The evaluation harness. The corpus only counts if a policy can train on it. You build the harness that decides which hours make the bank, and you hold the trainability bar as the volume grows. The first training runs. listings.description: about us Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world. For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses. AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years. At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. listings.description:
Mission

De nouveaux modèles, ouverts ou fermés, sortent chaque mois : encore faut-il choisir ceux qui sont assez bons pour la production, et le démontrer. Applications et agents s’appuient sur les grands modèles de langage (LLM), et la partie modèle de ces systèmes est entre vos mains. Nos clients s’en servent pour répondre à leurs propres clients, traiter des documents et interroger leurs connaissances.

Ce que le modèle voit, la manière dont il retrouve les connaissances, les outils qu’il peut appeler : ces choix vous appartiennent, de même que la mesure de la qualité des réponses. Le modèle retenu doit tenir l’objectif de coût et de qualité.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez savoir si un système d’IA donne des réponses justes, et pas seulement s’il tourne.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype AI Engineer.

 

Activités et responsabilités

Les Product Engineers construisent l’application autour du modèle ; le comportement du modèle à l’intérieur vous revient. Les Context & Analytics Engineers préparent les connaissances que vos agents retrouvent, et les Platform Engineers exploitent le serving, le harness et l’observabilité sur lesquels vous vous appuyez.

Avec l’AI Product Manager et les experts métier du client, une bonne réponse se définit, puis les résultats s’examinent ensemble. La relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues font partie du quotidien.

Vos responsabilités :

  • Construire des applications et des agents LLM : conception du contexte, appel d’outils, workflows multi-étapes.
  • Concevoir la façon

listings.title: ML Hydrologist, Flood Forecasting
listings.description: About the Role Global ML flood models now outperform traditional approaches on large rivers, but they still break down in the small, fast catchments where flash floods happen. Riverkin, a VC-backed ETH Zürich Spin-off, is closing that gap. We start from hydrological models trained across thousands of catchments worldwide and make them accurate locally, using a sensor network we deploy ourselves in exactly the places public datasets don't reach. We are looking for an ML hydrologist to own that work. You will report to the CTO and work directly with our other hydrologist, who covers rainfall radar and short-term nowcasting. Why this is interesting Data nobody else has: Our own field-deployed sensors give you live streamflow observations in small, previously ungauged catchments. An open problem: Whether large-sample models can be made reliable at flash-flood scale is unsolved, and you would be working on it with real data and real users. Built to protect lives and critical infrastructure: Your models will power early flood warning systems safeguarding hydropower plants and giving first responders more time to protect communities Publishing and open source: We encourage publishing results and contributing to open tools such as NeuralHydrology and Caravan. Compute: GPU resources are available for training and experimentation. What You'll Do Bring global flood models to the local scale Take state-of-the-art hydrological ML models (LSTMs, Transformers) trained on large-sample datasets and adapt them to the catchments our customers care about. Use our own sensor data alongside public gauge, reanalysis and radar data to fine-tune and validate those models locally. Tackle prediction in ungauged and data-scarce basins through transfer learning and regionalisation. Own hydrological modelling end to end: set the technical direction, decide when to adapt pre-trained models or train our own, and lead the work from experimentation through validation to production. Work as one model

listings.title: Senior Software Engineer, OS Integration
listings.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About the OS Integration team:

The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, updater, and enterprise DLP support.

listings.title: Stage Office Management (mbo/hbo)
listings.description: Een kerstviering organiseren waar collega's nog lang over napraten? Een externe bijeenkomst tot in de puntjes regelen? Of zorgen dat alles op kantoor lekker loopt? Bij Zibber krijg je de kans om het allemaal te doen. We zoeken een enthousiaste stagiair Office Management die energie krijgt van organiseren, regelen en dingen voor elkaar krijgen. Geen stage waarin je alleen maar meekijkt. Hier doe je écht mee! Over Zibber Met zo'n 240 collega's in Nederland, België en Duitsland zijn we marktleider in vastgoedmedia. Met fotografie, video en slimme technologie helpen we makelaars om woningen perfect te presenteren. Op ons hoofdkantoor in Eindhoven werken zo'n 60 collega's samen. De sfeer? Informeel, energiek en altijd in beweging. We werken hard, lachen veel en houden van mensen die initiatief nemen. De rol Binnen de stage Office Management werk je nauw samen met onze Executive Assistant en helpt bij alles wat ons kantoor en onze interne projecten nét wat beter maakt. Denk aan: Het organiseren van Zibber-events, borrels en teamactiviteiten. Het regelen van offsites en externe bijeenkomsten, van locatie tot catering. Zorgen dat alles op kantoor soepel verloopt. Contact met leveranciers en het oppakken van praktische verzoeken. Meewerken aan leuke interne projecten en verbeterideeën. En zie jij iets dat slimmer, leuker of makkelijker kan? Laat van je horen! Wat je van ons krijgt Een afwisselende stage waarin je écht iets kunt bijdragen. Ruimte om zelfstandig dingen op te pakken en eigen ideeën uit te voeren. Persoonlijke begeleiding van onze Executive Assistant. De kans om veel te leren over office management, events en projectmatig werken. Een werkplek op ons gezellige hoofdkantoor in Eindhoven. Korte lijnen, enthousiaste collega's en volop Zibber-events, lunches en gezelligheid. Een stagevergoeding van €450,- bruto per maand bij een fulltime stage. Bij een fulltime stage in principe vier dagen meewerken en één dag ruimte voor school. Starten in januari of februari 2027!

Als groeiend B-Corp familiebedrijf investeren we graag in jong talent en versterken we de verbinding tussen onderwijs en arbeidsmarkt. Daarom bieden we studenten de kans om praktijkervaring op te doen, zich te ontwikkelen en Nedlin te leren kennen, met waar mogelijk mooie doorgroeikansen na het afstuderen. De stageopdrachten Tijdens deze stage binnen Nedlin Industry ga je aan de slag met een actueel vraagstuk uit onze dagelijkse operatie. Je onderzoekt waar verbeterkansen liggen, brengt processen en knelpunten in kaart en werkt jouw bevindingen uit tot concrete verbetervoorstellen. Afhankelijk van jouw interesse kun je kiezen uit één van de volgende stageopdrachten: Klantcompleetheid verbeteren Onderzoek waar en waarom klantorders niet volledig worden geleverd, breng knelpunten binnen productie en expeditie in kaart en werk concrete verbeteringen. Gebruik van AI binnen de organisatie Onderzoek de mogelijkheden voor AI binnen de organisatie, bepaal kansrijke toepassingen voor de dagelijkse operatie en werk deze concreet uit. listings.title: US Remote Patient Care Advocate (Customer Service)
listings.description: Job Title: Patient Care Advocate Job Location: Remote About Us: We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. Role Overview: As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. What You’ll Do: Patient Enrollment & Eligibility : Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. Prescription Coverage : Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. Cost-Sharing & Payment : Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable.
